mintAuthority.summary: syrupUSDG is the canonical Ethereum Maple lending-pool share. Base USDG issuance is inherited from Paxos; local share eligibility and accounting depend on an upgradeable PoolManager and privileged protocol controls. CCIP representation mint/burn powers belong to Bridge Risk, not native issuance.
mintAuthority.headline: Maple's share accounting remains upgradeable, with an immediate security-admin path alongside delayed governor and delegate routes.

Verified upgrade() admits the delegate only after a valid Globals PM:UPGRADE scheduled call (current override 0/0 falls back to 604800-second delay and 172800-second execution window), or Globals securityAdmin without that delay. The factory requires an enabled version path, registered and enabled by the governor. There is no universal seven-day upgrade floor. liquidityCap() was 500000000 USDG, a mutable deposit ceiling rather than a bound on administrative claim impairment. These powers govern local share accounting, not base USDG issuance.

review.evidence: Native liability, current manager/factory/Globals bindings, complete indexed governor role-history census and all three Safe configurations were refreshed through Ethereum block 26197300 (2026-10-15T10:25:11Z). Six indexed RoleUpdated events resolve exactly to the six pinned live role memberships. Proposer 4-of-7, security 3-of-6 and operational 3-of-5 Safes retain their stored owners, empty module pages and zero guards. Operational owners are 0x57d1b1d5271390e161155a4594657facf05ccc7c, 0x8be3eb3c4f748f0ec660b996ef7e1d44f5d89736, 0x4024b08d3ffef9f7bced48c820e53edbc983307b, 0xf5703815842e06ce68940fa64eaa5bf36817d827 and 0x7371da5ac817c05547da65a84eacd72d653027af. Security-admin bypass makes the local upgrade-delay floor zero despite governor/delegate delays. This technical inventory does not establish execution-complete/key-custody certification, borrower quality or financial reconciliation. The Network Firm collateral dashboard names syrupUSDC and syrupUSDT, not syrupUSDG; Maple's own USDG analytics and protocol accounting do not establish independent whole-supply reconciliation. Supervision and reconciliation remain unknown.
